subject: Business Studies
central_question: How does planning convert organisational objectives into rational courses of action while dealing with uncertainty and practical limitations?

known_pitfalls.correction: Planning also sets objectives, evaluates alternatives and selects and implements action.
It anticipates and prepares for uncertainty but cannot eliminate it.

known_pitfalls.claim: Rules and policies are the same.
known_pitfalls.correction: A policy guides judgement; a rule prescribes action or prohibition.

ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Exercises contain Very Short Answer questions 1-5, Short Answer questions 1-6 and Long Answer questions 1-3.
